Basis: Existing no-skew/sparse/Whale control removes Maker reservation displacement but misses pullbacks and useful movement. Prior Reversion waits for turn/slowing. Test proactive heterogeneous stretch fades and independent portfolio demand using existing funded groups, separately then crossed.

Variants.control: Previous no-skew-sparse-whale mechanism unchanged; experimental CP30 barrier only
Variants.stretch: Reversion accounts adopt public-window stretch fades before turn, with finite staged entry, risk cap, staggered horizons and profit/time exits
Variants.portfolio: Value accounts adopt independent signed finite portfolio mandates with staged entry and time exits; no shared direction or last-price signal
Variants.mixed: Both independently tested styles on the same book
Variants.mixed-wide: Same combination but broader countertrend horizons

Funding: All existing bot identities, a.Kind, allocations, cash, limits and population counts preserved. Behavioral subtypes use dedicated saved state; no added accounts or capital.
Safety: Exact replay each run; restore preserves Engine/Population. News off. Stops, pauses and manual protections retain authority.
Gates: Unchanged from prior investigation; unused holdouts not opened.
